A. Mamdouh Kastour's Scholarly Anchor

ANCHOR framework by Amira Mamdouh Kastour. Developed with Claude (Anthropic).

In tribute to Mamdouh Kastour (1950-2020). The tribute portrait (img/tribute.png) is

Bundled software and data (each under its own licence; full texts in this folder):
  pdf.js 3.11.174 (Mozilla)                 Apache License 2.0        pdfjs-LICENSE.txt
  JSZip 3.10.1                              MIT or GPL-3 (MIT used)   jszip-LICENSE.md
  SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5          Apache License 2.0        sheetjs-LICENSE.txt
  Papa Parse 5.4.1                          MIT                       papaparse-LICENSE.txt
  world-atlas 2.0.2                         ISC                       world-atlas-ISC.txt
    (Natural Earth 1:110m country outlines, public domain)
  topojson-client 3.1.0 (build step only)   ISC                       topojson-client-ISC.txt
  IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic       SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 IBM-Plex-OFL.txt
  Source Serif 4                            SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 Source-Serif-4-OFL.txt

Bibliometric engine: a JavaScript port of functions of the bibliometrix R package 4.3.1
(Aria & Cuccurullo, 2017; GPL-3), including its country table. The sample dataset
(data/sample_management.json) is the "management" dataset of the bibliometrixData R package (GPL-3).
The English stop-word list is from the tidytext R package (stop_words; MIT; lists from the
SMART, snowball and onix collections).

Live services (used only when you switch them on; their own terms apply):
  Crossref REST API and doi.org (metadata CC0), OpenAlex (CC0), Research Organization Registry
  (CC0), ORCID public API, Anthropic Claude API (with your own key, only in API mode).

Licensed data and the published article PDF are never put in files the app makes for sharing.
